sounds.name: startup
sounds.prompt: Computer operating system startup chime, warm ethereal synth pad swelling up under sparkling glassy bell arpeggio, late 1990s desktop, uplifting, about five seconds, clean ending

sounds.name: shutdown
sounds.prompt: Computer shutdown chime, gentle descending glassy bell phrase settling onto a soft low synth pad, calm farewell, about three seconds

sounds.name: logon
sounds.prompt: User log-on welcome sound, short bright synth swell with a single shimmering bell on top, friendly, two seconds

sounds.name: ding
sounds.prompt: Single soft rounded computer ding, clean glass bell tone, short decay, desktop default beep

sounds.name: notify
sounds.prompt: Desktop notification pop, two quick rising glassy chime notes, light and pleasant, under one second

sounds.name: exclamation
sounds.prompt: Computer warning alert, bright attention-grabbing chord stab of bell tones, slightly tense, short

sounds.name: critical_stop
sounds.prompt: Computer critical error sound, low dissonant electronic thud with a harsh metallic chord, short and serious

sounds.name: question
sounds.prompt: Gentle questioning computer chime, two soft bell notes rising a fourth, curious tone, short

sounds.name: menu_click
sounds.prompt: One single soft mouse button click, short plastic tick, close-mic, no repeats

sounds.name: menu_popup
sounds.prompt: Soft airy menu open blip, quick breathy swish with a tiny high chime, very short user interface sound

sounds.name: minimize
sounds.prompt: Window minimize whoosh, quick downward airy swoosh falling in pitch, short user interface sound

sounds.name: maximize
sounds.prompt: Window maximize whoosh, quick upward airy swoosh rising in pitch, short user interface sound

sounds.name: recycle
sounds.prompt: Crumpling paper tossed into a metal wastebasket, crinkly and quick, close-mic

sounds.name: chat_in
sounds.prompt: Instant messenger message received, two quick soft bright chime notes, friendly pop, very short

sounds.name: chat_out
sounds.prompt: Chat message sent, soft quick whoosh ending in a tiny click, very short user interface sound

sounds.name: buddy_in
sounds.prompt: Creaky wooden door swinging open, short and playful, followed by a bright little chime

sounds.name: buddy_out
sounds.prompt: Wooden door closing with a soft solid thud, short, slightly echoey hallway

sounds.name: lobby_ready
sounds.prompt: Short triumphant retro video game ready fanfare, bright synth brass arpeggio, 16-bit arcade, two seconds

sounds.name: call_ring
sounds.prompt: Incoming video call ringtone, cheerful three-note bell melody played twice, clean electronic, under two seconds
